title: Staff accounts
lead: Who works at Aveline, and in which role. A change applies on that person’s next request.

SUPPORT.name: Support
SUPPORT.about: Runs a customer’s event for them: invitations and guests. Can’t delete an event or see billing.

ADMIN.name: Admin
ADMIN.about: Everything, including billing, deleting events and managing staff.

list.title: Staff
list.limit: Only the first {{count, number}}, by address, are shown.
list.refused: Only Aveline’s administrators manage staff accounts.

grant.title: Add someone to the staff
grant.lead: They need an Aveline account with a confirmed email address. Someone already on the staff gets the role chosen here.

errors.email: That doesn’t look like an email address.
errors.emailRefused: That address wasn’t accepted. Check it.
errors.notFound: No Aveline account uses this address. Ask them to create one first.
errors.unverified: This account hasn’t confirmed its email address yet. Ask them to open the link Aveline sent.

change.title: Make {{name}} {{role}}?
change.ADMIN: An admin can do everything at Aveline, including billing, deleting events and managing staff. It applies on their next request.
change.SUPPORT: They keep running customers’ events, but lose what only an admin may do, such as billing, deleting events and managing staff. It applies on their next request.

remove.title: Remove {{name}} from the staff?
remove.body: Their account stays, as an ordinary one: on their next request the staff pages close to them.

status.removed: {{name}} is no longer on the staff.

refused.forbidden: Only Aveline’s administrators manage staff accounts.
refused.selfChange: You can’t change your own role. Ask another administrator.
refused.gone: That account was no longer on the staff. The list is up to date again.
refused.notFound: No Aveline account uses this address. Ask them to create one first.
refused.unverified: This account hasn’t confirmed its email address yet.
refused.emailRefused: That address wasn’t accepted. Check it.
refused.rateLimited: Too many tries. Wait a minute, then try again.
refused.noAnswer: No answer came. It may have gone through, so check the list, then try again.
refused.other: This wasn’t accepted. The reason, in English:
